memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The steward took the men into Joseph's house, gave them water to wash their feet and provided fodder for their donkeys. They prepared their gifts for Joseph's arrival at noon, because they had heard that they were to eat there." - Gen 43:24-25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The brothers are brought into Joseph's house and shown warm hospitality — water to wash their travel-worn feet, and fodder even for their donkeys. Every need is cared for. Then, hearing they are to dine with the ruler, they prepare their gifts. The men who arrived frightened and expecting the worst are instead welcomed, refreshed, and honoured.

There is grace in these small details. Washing the feet of weary travelers and feeding their animals were acts of genuine care and welcome. Joseph, through his steward, was treating these men — who did not yet know who he was — with tenderness and hospitality. Kindness was being poured out on them at every turn.

This reminds us of the value of hospitality and practical care. Sometimes the most powerful way to show God's love is not through grand gestures but through simple attentiveness to people's needs — a meal, a place to rest, a kindness that says, "You are welcome here." Scripture urges us to "practice hospitality" (Rom 12:13) and reminds us that in welcoming others, we sometimes welcome more than we know (Heb 13:2).

Consider how you might offer this kind of welcome to those around you — the weary, the stranger, the one who arrives anxious and unsure. A washed foot, a shared meal, a warm reception can carry the love of God in tangible form. And receive, too, the welcome God extends to you: He brings His weary children into His house and cares for their every need.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. How can I offer practical hospitality and care to those around me?
2. Do I welcome the weary and the stranger with genuine kindness?
3. How has God shown me the welcome of bringing me into His care?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, make me a person of genuine hospitality, welcoming and caring for others in practical ways. Thank You for the welcome You extend to me, bringing me into Your house and meeting my needs. Amen.
